1 The above standalone results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on October 22 2026. The Statutory Auditors have conducted a limited review of these unaudited standalone financial results and issued an unmodified review report thereon.

2 These standalone financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards Ind AS prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 along with the relevant rules issued thereunder and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 as amended Listing Regulations.

4 The Company publishes these financial results along with the consolidated financial results. In accordance with Ind AS 108 Operating Segments the Company has disclosed the segment information in the consolidated financial results.

5 During the quarter ended September 30 2026 the Swiggy Employee Stock Option Trust Trust has transferred 2849658 equity shares of Rs. 1 each pursuant to the exercise of stock options by employees under various Employee Stock Option Schemes.

6 During the quarter ended September 30 2026 Swiggy Limited incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary Swiggy Commerce Private Limited which has not yet commenced business operations.

7 Consequent to the Board approval on September 23 2025 and the subsequent approval by the shareholders on November 01 2025 the Company has presented its Quick Commerce business Instamart as Discontinued Operations for all comparative periods in its standalone financial results in accordance with Ind AS 105 following the transfer of the Instamart business on a going concern basis by way of a slump sale to Swiggy Instamart Private Limited a wholly owned step down subsidiary of the Company. This transfer became effective on April 01 2026.

8 During the year ended March 31 2026 the Company had opted for the conversion of inter corporate deposits ICDs aggregating to Rs. 1130 Crore given to its wholly owned subsidiary Swiggy Retail Limited formerly known as Supr Infotech Solutions Limited Supr Infotech Solutions Private Limited into 0.001% Compulsorily Convertible Debentures CCDs resulting in full settlement of the ICDs with no financial impact in the Standalone Statement of Profit and Loss.

Subsequent to the quarter ended September 30 2026 the Company has opted for the conversion of inter corporate deposits ICDs aggregating to Rs. 2406 Crore including accrued interest given to its wholly owned subsidiary Swiggy Networks Limited formerly known as Swiggy Networks Private Limited Scootsy Logistics Private Limited into 0.001% Compulsorily Convertible Debentures CCDs resulting in full settlement of the ICDs. The conversion has no financial impact in the Standalone Statement of Profit and Loss.

9 During the quarter ended June 30 2026 the Company acquired certain Property Plant and Equipment from its wholly owned subsidiary Swiggy Networks Limited formerly known as Swiggy Networks Private Limited Scootsy Logistics Private Limited for Rs. 49 Crore March 31 2026 Rs. 818 Crore at book value being fair value to align asset ownership within the Group.

10 During the year ended March 31 2026 the Company completed the sale of its entire investment in Roppen Transportation Services Private Limited Rapido for a consideration of Rs. 2399 Crore pursuant to requisite Board and shareholder approvals. Accordingly a gain of Rs. 1350 Crore was recognised in Other Comprehensive Income.

11 During the year ended March 31 2026 the Company allotted 266666663 equity shares of face value Rs. 1 each to eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers QIB at an issue price of Rs. 375 per equity share including premium of Rs. 374 per equity share aggregating to Rs. 10000 Crore pursuant to Qualified Institutions Placement QIP in accordance with the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of lndia Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements Regulations the SEBI ICDR Regulations.

12 Changes in Board and Senior Management
During the quarter ended June 30 2026 Mr Lakshmi Nandan Reddy Obul DIN 06686145 Whole Time Director Head of Innovation and Mr Roger Clark Rabalais DIN 07304038 Nominee Director resigned with effect from April 10 2026. Mr Renan De Castro Alves Pinto DIN 03118947 was appointed as Non Executive Non Independent Nominee Director with effect from April 11 2026.

During the quarter ended September 30 2026 Mr Amitesh Kumar Jha resigned as the CEO Instamart and ceased to be a Senior Management Personnel SMP of the Company with effect from July 28 2026. Ms Nandita Sinha was appointed as the CEO Instamart and categorised as SMP with effect from August 3 2026.

13 Amounts which are less than half a crore are appearing as 0.

14 The standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30 2026 are also being made available on the Stock Exchange websites www.bseindia.com and www.nseindia.com and on the Companys website www.swiggy.com.
